title: A soldier that has crossed the river is a chase target
rationale: The same one-sided rook shuttle as xq-chs-001, against a soldier that has crossed the river and so may step sideways to escape. In Xiangqi such a soldier is an ordinary chase target and the chaser loses. This is where the two games differ: Mini Xiangqi excludes soldiers as chase targets altogether, and mx-chs-003 is the same shuttle there ending in a claimable draw. A build that applied one game's chase-target rule to both fails one of the two fixtures whichever way it chose.
